svg.aria-label: Interactify deployment on an Android phone: a push to main auto-deploys the Next.js client to Vercel, and GitHub Actions builds and tests the server, then copies it over SSH through Cloudflare Access and a Cloudflare Tunnel to a Samsung Galaxy J6 running Termux, where PM2 runs the WebSocket server and cloudflared, Redis handles pub/sub, and the server writes directly to MongoDB Atlas with Kafka turned off.
svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: phone has no public IP or open ports
Termux on Android · the production server
What changed from the EC2 setup

g.text: Cloudflare Tunnel, dialled out from the phone
docker push → Docker Hub → docker pull
CI builds dist/, sends it over scp + ssh via Access
PM2 processes and a native redis-server
Kafka + Zookeeper in the write path
Kafka off; the server writes to MongoDB directly
